contentText: Swiss investigators are probing what caused a fire in a bar at an Alpine ski resort that left around 40 people dead and another 115 injured during a New Year's celebration. The severity of the burns has made it very difficult to identify bodies, and Swiss authorities say it could take weeks before all victims have been identified. FRANCE 24's Olivia Bizot spoke to several witnesses of the fire in Crans-Montana.
